# Returns policy

Items may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused and in there original packaging. Sale items are final and can not be returned.

To start a return, log in to your account and select the order. A prepaid shipping label will be emailed to you within one business day.

labels.notes: "can not" vs "cannot": "cannot" is standard, but "can not" is not strictly wrong; left optional.
